title: Animals
intro:
Animals are of course the reason a zoo exists. Players start with a few animals, and more become available as the game progresses. Most animals can be purchased with coins or diamonds. 
Before a new animal can be placed, players must build the appropriate enclosure. Each animal requires a species-specific enclosure and a certain amount of enclosure space, and the maximum number of animals per enclosure must not be exceeded. 
Adding a trough, a water hole, and enrichment items to the enclosure increases XP yield by 5%.

animal_package.intro_package: Purchasing diamond packages often includes exclusive bonus animals. Players receive one or two Premium bonus animals when buying 100+ diamonds. The most expensive diamond package awards an exclusive VIP bonus animal or a pair of Premium bonus animals. Premium bonus animals change every two weeks and VIP bonus animals every 8 weeks. Check forecasts for current pattern predictions on when bonus animals should change and which animals are expected to be skipped from chest rotations. Some earlier animals are sometimes offered again. Upjers also allows players to trade a current bonus animal for a selected list of previously offered bonus animals.
animal_package.how_step1: Purchase a diamond package that includes bonus animals.
animal_package.how_step2: Leave the animals in the sidebar inventory after the purchase. Do NOT place them in your zoo. If you want to trade, do not select the NPC, as this creates more work for support.
animal_package.how_step3: Open a support ticket with Upjers at support.upjers.com. Explain that you purchased a package and would like to trade the animals. Be sure to include your Support ID (user ID), your username, and the desired animals. The animals must be the current Premium or VIP offer, so trade them before the next rotation.
animal_package.how_step4: Upjers typically completes the trade within one to two business days.
animal_package.exclusions_body: Trading bonus animals is a goodwill service and not an official game feature, so Upjers may decide at any time to discontinue the animal trade.
animal_package.exclusion_premium: Premium bonus animals can only be traded for Premium; VIP can be traded for a VIP or a pair of Premium.
animal_package.exclusion_pairs: Animals received in pairs can only be traded as pairs.
animal_package.exclusion_list: You can only trade for a specific list of animals.
animal_package.exclusion_enclosure: Support only trades the animals, not the enclosure. If the enclosure of the requested trade animal differs from the one given with the package, players are responsible for obtaining the correct enclosure themselves.
animal_package.tradelist_body: Currently you can only trade for a limited selection of animals. The official goodwill trade list can be requested from Upjers Support. The animal page shows a blue diamond icon with a P (Premium) or V (VIP), indicating which animals are known to be on the current list. A grey diamond icon means the animal is no longer on the trade list but was previously a Premium or VIP animal.
animal_package.tradelist_tip_body: You should check the chest forecasts to see if the animal is expected to appear in chests soon, where you could get it for free. Also look at Skipped Animals, which are not expected to appear in chests. Some animals are also rarely offered as a Super Deal.

animal_breeding.title: Breeding
animal_breeding.intro: Breeding allows you to produce baby animals in your zoo. With the right setup, bonuses, and timing, you can maximize your chances of special coat colors and optimize your breeding plan. You can breed all biomes in the Oceanside Zoo! Use the terrain editor to change the ground to blue tiles to place grasslands, plains, forest, mountain, savanna, ice, and jungle enclosures in the Oceanside Zoo. You can breed all biomes in this region, not just water.
animal_breeding.requirements_body: For breeding you need: an adult male and female of the same species, a breeding shelter at the required level, enough coins to start the breeding, and a free breeding slot.
animal_breeding.how_to_breed_body: Tap a breeding shelter or breeding center slot and then select the animal. You can optionally add fertility food to improve the chances of special coat colors. When the timer expires, collect the baby. After collecting, there is an 8-hour rest period before the shelter can be used again. Gestation periods range from 2 to 16 hours depending on the species. The exact time for each species is shown in the breeding center.
animal_breeding.simultaneous_body: You can breed in multiple enclosures simultaneously. The order in which you collect babies affects the failed breeding bonus — a failed breeding adds a bonus percentage to your next attempt. The result is determined the moment you tap to collect.
animal_breeding.twins_body: Twins and triplets are guaranteed during Breeding Week events. Outside of events, a Zoo Academy subscription gives a chance of twins or triplets. Note that breeding must BEGIN during the event window to qualify for the guaranteed twins/triplets.
animal_breeding.growing_up_body: Babies take 7 days to grow into adults. You can pause aging by moving a baby to your inventory. Babies give double the popularity of adults. Growing up awards a small amount of XP.
animal_breeding.power_growth_body: You can instantly grow an animal by using diamonds (Power Growth Formula). This is often discounted during Breeding Week.
animal_breeding.reducing_time_body: Several methods reduce breeding time: pay diamonds (5 per remaining hour), watch an ad (10% reduction, app only), use a Speed Fertility Food bag (20% reduction, earned during Conservation Week, stackable), or the Zoo Academy subscription (up to 80% reduction).
animal_breeding.reducing_rest_body: The 8-hour rest period after collecting can be reduced by paying 1 diamond per remaining hour. App users can watch an ad for a 10% reduction.
animal_breeding.bonuses_body: Several bonuses stack to increase your chance of special coat colors.
animal_breeding.bonus_club: Club Boost: 2–10% bonus, active during 48-hour club events. Must be activated BEFORE starting the breeding.
animal_breeding.bonus_academy: Zoo Academy: Increased base percentage by biome. Varies by species.
animal_breeding.bonus_fertility: Fertility Food: Standard gives base %; Premium gives 4× base % (stackable); Video ad gives base % (limit 1 per breeding, up to 20 ads per 24 hours).
animal_breeding.bonus_failed: Failed Breeding: Adds base % or 10% (whichever is lower) per failed attempt. Maximum 75% bonus. Carries over across regions and slots.
animal_breeding.bonus_region: Region Bonus: +50% base rate in the matching region (Fir Grove=Forest, Kujali Park=Plains & Savanna, Oceanside Zoo=Water, Polar Park=Ice, Rainforest Park=Jungle).
animal_breeding.special_coats_body: Tap the blue info button on a breeding shelter to see the chances of special coat colors for that species. The chances are increased during special events. The parents' colors influence which color options are available for the baby.
animal_breeding.animal_levels_body: Baby level = Round down((Mother level + Father level) / 2) + 1. The maximum level is 20 (sparkling animals go up to level 40). Each level adds 5% to the animal's base popularity. Babies always give double popularity.
animal_breeding.animal_xp_body: Animal XP is the same at every level, except when the animal comes from the Rescue Center — those animals give double XP.
animal_breeding.region_bonus_body: Breeding in the matching region for a species gives +50% on the base special coat rate.

super_deals.title: Super Deals
super_deals.intro: Super Deals (also known as Top Deals or Flash Sales) are time-limited discount offers in the Zoo 2 shop. They typically last 24–72 hours and change around noon in Germany.
super_deals.how_it_works_body: Super Deals appear in the shop for a limited time. The most common type bundles an animal pair with an enclosure, a water hole, and enclosure items at a discount of 39–84%. Discounts are calculated including the coin-to-diamond conversion rate of 1 diamond per 250 coins.
super_deals.types_body: Super Deals come in various forms. The most common type combines two animals with an enclosure package. Less common types include color variant animals at full diamond price, discounted event decorations, and animals from VIP, Legendary, or Friendship chests.
super_deals.discontinued_body: Safari Restaurants and Zoo Shops were previously available as Super Deals but have been discontinued. Their unlimited purchase potential caused a coin imbalance in the game economy. These items are now available through Season Pass rewards, the Shell Game, seasonal events, and new zoo regions.

animal_sparkling.title: Sparkling Animals
animal_sparkling.intro: A successful breeding of any species or variant can randomly produce a special, sparkling animal of the same species. Sparkling animals glow with a glittering, violet-glowing aura due to their exceptional health and contain high popularity. Sparkling animals can only be obtained through regular breeding and are extremely rare.
animal_sparkling.overview_body: Every sparkling animal is born at level 40, regardless of its parents' levels. Sparkling animals are the only animals that can reach such a high level in your zoo. All non-sparkling animals reach their maximum level at level 20.
animal_sparkling.streak_body: The chance of obtaining a sparkling animal is determined by your breeding streak — the number of consecutive successful breedings per species. Once a breeding fails, the streak for that species resets to zero. Each species has its own breeding streak, displayed in the bottom right of the breeding dialog. Whether the outcome is a single, twins, or triplets, the session counts as a single attempt.
animal_sparkling.chances_body: The higher the number of consecutive successful breedings for a species, the greater your chances of obtaining a sparkling animal on the next breeding attempt. The chances start at 0.1% at a streak of zero and rise to a maximum of 1.1% at a streak of 10 or more. Each individual baby in a twin or triplet pair has its own chance of being born as a sparkling animal.
animal_sparkling.breeding_with_body: Once a sparkling animal has grown up, it can be used to breed level 20 babies, allowing you to skip levels. Regardless of the level or sparkling property of the other parent, babies should produce a normal level 20, with an ultra-rare chance of obtaining another sparkling level 40 animal. Sparkling animals also instantly fulfill all collection goals for the same species and color, since they are born at level 40.
animal_sparkling.donating_body: When you donate a level 40 sparkling animal to a club contest, the animal gives the same points as its level: 400 club points, as shown on the member donation screen. This is equivalent to donating two level 20 animals.
animal_sparkling.glow_body: If you do not like the sparkling effects, you can disable the sparkling feature in the game settings. Click the gear icon in the bottom right of your game screen, click the second settings tab, scroll down, and check the box for "Show sparkling animals as normal animals". This removes all sparkling effects from your level 40 animals.

animal_petting.petting_body: Some tasks require petting an animal. Click on the animal and hold until the camera zooms in and small hearts float up from the animal. Tips: Enable "Reduced Animations" in settings so your animals do not move. Choose a larger animal if the task does not specify a particular one. Zoom in so the animals are larger and you have a bigger target.

ice_cream_vendor.title: Ice Cream Vendor
ice_cream_vendor.intro: The Ice Cream Vendor (ICV) is a special NPC who regularly visits your zoo and offers discounted animals from his cart. He is one of the best ways to obtain rare animals at a reduced price.
ice_cream_vendor.how_it_works_body: The Ice Cream Vendor visits your zoo approximately every 44 hours. Upon arrival, he offers up to 3 animals at a discount of 14–40% off the regular price. You have 1 hour to make your purchases before he departs again. The vendor checks which animals you already have placed in your zoo and will not offer you animals you already own.
ice_cream_vendor.deals_body: Each visit features 1 to 3 animals from his pool. Discounts range from 14% to 40% off the regular purchase price. The discounted price is shown directly at the vendor's cart. You can purchase all offered animals within the 1-hour window.
ice_cream_vendor.obtaining_body: The animals available from the Ice Cream Vendor can also be obtained through other sources, such as the main zoo shop, special chests, the club shop, Super Deals, or the Rescue Center. The table below lists the animals in his pool along with their alternative sources.
ice_cream_vendor.npc_body: The Ice Cream Vendor is a friendly NPC character who pushes his cart through your zoo. He appears as a notification when he arrives. Tap his cart to see the current selection. If you miss him, you must wait approximately 44 hours for his next visit.
